settings.title: How to ask for reviews without feeling awkward

tabs.tab_title: Is it allowed to ask for reviews?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, as long as you ask every customer and don’t offer rewards for reviews. We keep everything within Google’s guidelines.
We help you respond quickly and professionally. A thoughtful reply to a bad review often builds more trust than another five stars.
Yes, when they’re simple and feel like a thank-you. We’ll design rewards that fit your business and margins.
Most businesses see new reviews within the first week of automated requests, and steady growth from there.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy Reviews & Referrals on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because reviews & referrals works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
